newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine official sees unemployment falling.
newsitem.headline: Argentine official sees unemployment falling.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister's chief aide Carlos Rodriguez estimated Tuesday that if the rebound in economic growth continues, unemployment could fall by five percentage points in a year and a half.

Rodriguez told journalists that in order to sustain this rise in employment it is necessary to reduce employer contributions although such cuts have to be agreed with other sectors of the country since a large drop could hurt the public accounts.

Separately, Rodriguez said the government maintained its goal of reducing the budget deficit next year to one percent of gross domestic product. That level is compatible with four to five percent growth in 1997 and as such "the deficit can be financed," he said.
